priority3_runtime_actor_extractions.mechanism: Two-tier deterministic caching inside a mainstream browser-agent SDK. ActCache: caches individual act() results keyed by (sanitized instruction, normalized page URL, sorted variable-keys); replay waits for cached selector attachment (waitForCachedSelector, default 15s timeout) before executing; MISS/self-heal falls back to live LLM resolution. AgentCache: records entire multi-step executions (act/fillForm/nav steps incl. LLM reasoning artifacts) and replays deterministically; serverAgentCache wraps V3 for payload transfer without disk writes; env:'BROWSERBASE' gets managed server-side caching with cacheStatus HIT/MISS returned from act()/extract(). Vendor-documented effect (OFFICIAL_CLAIM): cold 15–60+s → cached 1–5s, 0 tokens.
priority3_runtime_actor_extractions.evidence_tier: CODE_VERIFIED (v4 branch source tree contains packages/core/lib/v3/cache/{ActCache,AgentCache,CacheStorage,serverAgentCache,utils}.ts; key-construction logic read directly in-source this cycle) + OFFICIAL_CLAIM for performance deltas (vendor docs/DeepWiki-indexed docs)
priority3_runtime_actor_extractions.spider_relevance: Strongest public baseline DESIGN for any SPIDER action/fragment cache: state-keyed deterministic replay + explicit staleness validation + self-healing fallback mirrors SPIDER's no-silent-substitution needs at the action layer. new_actors_beyond_seed_cycle5.mechanism: Standalone Node.js CLI: Playwright/CDP browse → filter XHR/fetch + /api|/graphql|/rest URLs → extract auth headers (Bearer/CSRF/platform-specific) → dedupe endpoints by method+path → markdown+JSON catalog; separate 'http' mode replays discovered endpoints with saved session cookies + CSRF auto-injection without a browser; stealth flag via puppeteer-extra-stealth.

new_actors_beyond_seed_cycle5.name: MorphNet (github.com/suswader/morphnet)
new_actors_beyond_seed_cycle5.mechanism: Computer-use-as-discovery: always-on CDP observer captures HTTP traffic WITH initiator stack traces + CU actions/reasoning + DOM snapshots + framework fingerprints; background learner builds deterministic execution graphs (12-step pipeline, ONE total LLM call for naming/capability_statement); executor re-invokes THE SITE'S OWN JavaScript via CDP using a 5-strategy entry-point fallback (window global → framework store dispatch → extracted IIFE → DOM replay → give up) instead of reconstructing HTTP externally; parameter roles {user_intent, chained, captured_constant, session_derived}; bundle-sha256 preconditions escalate to canary test on mismatch, repeated failure degrades the graph; retrieval filters by URL-pattern precondition then ranks by capability_statement embedding cosine.
new_actors_beyond_seed_cycle5.evidence_tier: CODE_VERIFIED surface (README/architecture; public MIT repo) but 0 stars, single author, last push 2026-05-24, no measured claims found
new_actors_beyond_seed_cycle5.significance: Distinct replay substrate in the same ladder family: in-page JS invocation sidesteps TLS-fingerprint/signature walls that break external HTTP replay, at the price of keeping a persistent browser alive (Unbrowse's core claim is dropping the browser entirely). Defines one axis the reproduction's failure-mode characterization should note.
new_actors_beyond_seed_cycle5.verdict: RADAR — alternate-ladder-tier follow-up; immaturity bars candidacy this cycle

new_papers_cycle5.paper: APISensor: Robust Discovery of Web API from Runtime Traffic Logs (arXiv:2603.23852)
new_papers_cycle5.mechanism: Unsupervised black-box API reconstruction from mixed runtime traffic: noise filtering (weighted structural features p<0.01 drop) + path normalization, then TWO-STAGE clustering — structure-level abstraction grouping requests by interface shape (method/path-depth/identifier-placeholder/query/JSON-payload features), then semantic refinement within template groups via graph-based clustering. Reported: Group Accuracy Precision 95.92%, F1 94.91%, six web apps, >10k requests, lowest variance among 10 baselines incl. APICARV/APIDrain3/Mitmproxy2Swagger/Optic; uncovered undocumented Dify shadow APIs later confirmed by developers.
new_papers_cycle5.evidence_tier: PAPER_EVIDENCE (full method described; no public code found in this cycle's quick search — UNKNOWN license)
new_papers_cycle5.significance: Best publicly measured method for exactly the Unbrowse ladder's extraction stage; sets a quality bar and a candidate algorithm for SPIDER's clean-room endpoint parameterization.

new_papers_cycle5.paper: HANSEL: Extracting Breadcrumbs from Web Agent Trajectories for Interactive Verification (arXiv:2606.18671)
new_papers_cycle5.mechanism: Extracts evidence pages/snippets from agent trajectories into interactive views with preserved page state; flags untraceable answers; 83.7% precision / 88.8% recall evidence-page identification, −61.6% trajectory volume, improved human verification UX in n=14 study.
new_papers_cycle5.significance: Verification/transparency mechanism for accumulated procedure knowledge (human-audit interface); adjacent to Graph provenance presentation, not a memory mechanism.

new_papers_cycle5.paper: Software Testing at the Network Layer (arXiv:2602.08242)
new_papers_cycle5.mechanism: Playwright HAR capture protocol (DOMContentLoaded → ≤5s network idle → 3-viewport scroll → 3s lazy-load settle) + 8 anti-pattern detectors over 18 production sites/108 HARs; documents pervasive redundant calls and missing cache headers.
new_papers_cycle5.significance: Reusable HAR capture protocol reference for the reproduction's discovery pass; contextualizes why naive full-render baselines waste time (third-party overhead >20% on 72% of sites).

new_papers_cycle5.paper: Do Agent Benchmarks Measure Capability? Protocol Validity in the Age of Agentic AI (arXiv:2607.22368)
new_papers_cycle5.mechanism: HackDetect: post-hoc audit attributing Exposure→Exploit→Mislead chains in benchmark traces; Mislead gap G = S_exploit − S_intended computed only against defensible comparisons.
new_papers_cycle5.significance: Evaluation-methodology adjacent; aligns with SPIDER auditor doctrine (protocol exposure ≠ score inflation without attribution); no direct mechanism transfer.

new_papers_cycle5.paper: Deceptive Model Claims in Shadow APIs (arXiv:2603.01919)
new_papers_cycle5.mechanism: Fingerprinting + Model Equality Testing reveal 45.83% of evaluated third-party 'shadow' LLM endpoints misrepresent model identity; proposes four-stage auditor verification pipeline (≥24 fingerprint probes; MET ≥500 samples α=.05; ≥3 held-out sessions variance checks; registration/provenance check). NOTE: 'shadow API' here means unofficial MODEL-endpoint resellers, NOT website first-party APIs — terminology collision documented.
new_papers_cycle5.significance: Directly reusable verification-protocol pattern for any SPIDER shared-infrastructure trust design where contributed capabilities/endpoints must prove identity and stability.
